caption: A cold bottle of milk is poured into a glass on a hot patio, and the outside of the glass mists over.

sa.check: Milk is poured from a bottle into a glass.
The outside of the glass mists over.
The mist reaches up to the level of the milk in the glass.
The setting is a hot patio.

pc.expect: The misting only builds while the glass holds the cold milk, and the beads grow and join rather than clearing.
pc.fail: The mist clears while the cold milk stays in the glass; or the glass mists and dries in turn; or the glass is misted before the milk is poured; or the beads shrink while the glass is still cold.

pc.expect: The drops run downward on the outside of the glass and gather at its foot or wet the table.
pc.fail: A drop runs up the glass; or water gathers on the rim's top and stays; or a drop leaves the glass and rises; or a run travels sideways round the glass and stays level.

pc.expect: The mist reaches up the glass to the milk's level and the glass above that line stays clearer.
pc.fail: The misting is heaviest above the milk's level and absent below it; or the whole glass including the empty part mists equally from the first frame; or mist forms on the inside of the glass; or the glass mists before any milk is in it.

pc.expect: The beads behave as water on glass: rounded, merging when they touch and running as streaks, and the milk is a thin liquid that finds its level.
pc.fail: Touching drops overlap without merging; or drops jump about on the glass; or the milk stands in a heap above the rim; or the beads turn to frost on the glass in the heat.

pc.expect: One bottle and one glass; the milk goes from bottle to glass and nowhere else.
pc.fail: Milk appears in the glass with no stream reaching it; or the glass's level jumps; or the milk passes through the glass's wall; or a second glass appears.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bottle's label, the glass's shape and the patio table stay the same.
pc.fail: The label changes; or the glass changes shape; or the table's setting rearranges.
